entries.title: John 15:1
segments: ¶"I am the true vine, and My Father is the vinedresser.

entries.title: John 15:2
segments: "Every branch in Me that does not bear fruit He takes away; and every [branch] that bears fruit He prunes, that it may bear more fruit.

entries.title: John 15:3
segments: "You are already clean because of the word which I have spoken to you.

entries.title: John 15:4
segments: "Abide in Me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, unless it abides in the vine, neither can you, unless you abide in Me.

entries.title: John 15:5
segments: "I am the vine, you [are] the branches. He who abides in Me, and I in him, bears much fruit; for without Me you can do nothing.

entries.title: John 15:6
segments: "If anyone does not abide in Me, he is cast out as a branch and is withered; and they gather them and throw [them] into the fire, and they are burned.

entries.title: John 15:7
segments: "If you abide in Me, and My words abide in you, you will ask what you desire, and it shall be done for you.

entries.title: John 15:8
segments: "By this My Father is glorified, that you bear much fruit; so you will be My disciples.

entries.title: John 15:9
segments: ¶"As the Father loved Me, I also have loved you; abide in My love.

entries.title: John 15:10
segments: "If you keep My commandments, you will abide in My love, just as I have kept My Father's commandments and abide in His love.

entries.title: John 15:11
segments: "These things I have spoken to you, that My joy may remain in you, and [that] your joy may be full.

entries.title: John 15:12
segments: "This is My commandment, that you love one another as I have loved you.

entries.title: John 15:13
segments: "Greater love has no one than this, than to lay down one's life for his friends.

entries.title: John 15:14
segments: "You are My friends if you do whatever I command you.

entries.title: John 15:15
segments: "No longer do I call you servants, for a servant does not know what his master is doing; but I have called you friends, for all things that I heard from My Father I have made known to you.

entries.title: John 15:16
segments: "You did not choose Me, but I chose you and appointed you that you should go and bear fruit, and [that] your fruit should remain, that whatever you ask the Father in My name He may give you.

entries.title: John 15:17
segments: "These things I command you, that you love one another.

entries.title: John 15:18
segments: ¶"If the world hates you, you know that it hated Me before [it hated] you.

entries.title: John 15:19
segments: "If you were of the world, the world would love its own. Yet because you are not of the world, but I chose you out of the world, therefore the world hates you.

entries.title: John 15:20
segments: "Remember the word that I said to you, 'A servant is not greater than his master.' If they persecuted Me, they will also persecute you. If they kept My word, they will keep yours also.

entries.title: John 15:21
segments: "But all these things they will do to you for My name's sake, because they do not know Him who sent Me.

entries.title: John 15:22
segments: "If I had not come and spoken to them, they would have no sin, but now they have no excuse for their sin.

entries.title: John 15:23
segments: "He who hates Me hates My Father also.

entries.title: John 15:24
segments: "If I had not done among them the works which no one else did, they would have no sin; but now they have seen and also hated both Me and My Father.

entries.title: John 15:25
segments: "But [this happened] that the word might be fulfilled which is written in their law, 'They hated Me without a cause.'

entries.title: John 15:26
segments: ¶"But when the Helper comes, whom I shall send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth who proceeds from the Father, He will testify of Me.

entries.title: John 15:27
segments: "And you also will bear witness, because you have been with Me from the beginning.
